items.title: A product of pairs is henselian exactly when each factor is
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises henselian pairs among arbitrary products: the product pair is henselian if and only if every factor is. One direction is immediate from the fact that each projection is an integral ring map and the permanence of the henselian property under integral maps. For the other, the author works componentwise: elements of one plus the product ideal are units because they are componentwise, which puts the product ideal inside the Jacobson radical, and then a monic polynomial over the product with a factorisation of its reduction generating the unit ideal admits a lift of the factorisation because it does in every factor, which is exactly the defining property of a henselian pair.
